definitions.explanation: Matters relating to the military, armed forces, warfare, or defense. Frequently used as a prefix modifying other nouns.

examples.japanese: {軍事|ぐんじ}{力|りょく}を{強化|きょうか}する。
その{地域|ちいき}では{軍事|ぐんじ}{衝突|しょうとつ}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Military conflicts continue in that region.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{軍事|ぐんじ}{同盟|どうめい}を{結|むす}び、{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}で{協力|きょうりょく}している。
examples.english: The two countries formed a military alliance and cooperate on security.

notes:
{軍事|ぐんじ} is most commonly used as a modifier preceding other nouns, functioning like an adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{力|りょく} (military power)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{基地|きち} (military base)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{同盟|どうめい} (military alliance)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{作戦|さくせん} (military operation)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{費|ひ} (military expenditure)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{政権|せいけん} (military regime)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (military technology)

Distinct from {軍|ぐん} (army, military force) which refers to the armed forces themselves. {軍事|ぐんじ} is more abstract, referring to military matters, policy, or affairs as a category.
